notes: Partition verified: all 16 source and 23 target IDs used exactly once, with two added units.

Two English words are added: the protasis *if*, which no conjunction morpheme licenses since the waw and הִנֵּה already hold *and* and *behold* (rule 55's own Leviticus example), and the *and* opening *and have testified falsely*, a clause in which no waw stands (rule 14's closing count).
הֵיטֵב takes the distinct adverbial word *diligent* the ASV spends on it (rule 56); the finite verb keeps *shall make … inquisition*, headed on the complement under rule 44.
